fichas.title: Stadiums: Overview and spectator stands
fichas.summary: Overview of stadium layouts, site planning, orientation, spectator viewing and circulation, evacuation stair capacity, support facilities, parking, and stand sections. Stadium forms include U-shaped, segmented, semi-circular-ended, curved-sided, and horseshoe layouts. The text recommends planning for terrain, transport and utilities, avoiding nearby industry, and orienting European arenas northeast–southwest so spectators generally have the sun behind them. The symbolic stair-width formula is given as number of spectators divided by evacuation time in seconds multiplied by 1.25; no value is calculated here.
